contexts.text: What is hot was felt exhaling from that arm.
They are cold, and eagerly desire to become hot.
The same, in order to become hot, seem to themselves to be sawing wood.
Thou art neither cold nor hot () = that those who are such now deny that the Word is Divine and holy, and now acknowledge it. AR 203.
Therefore, because thou art Luke warm, and neither cold nor hot, it will come to pass that I shall vomit thee out of My mouth () = profanation, and consequent separation from the Lord.
If he is hot he is like a torch lighted on a hearth...
Thou art neither cold nor hot = that it is between Heaven and Hell, because devoid of charity... Hot = to be in spiritual love.
Would thou wert cold or hot = that it is better there should be no faith, or that there should be charity alone. Explained.
